round: relevance-filtering research round 12 (zukhruf #3383, step 1): does words + meaning rank better than today's ranker?
writtenBefore: the fifth fresh slice (2025-01-01..2025-03-31) is crawled, read, labelled or embedded, and before any round-12 score.
why: The user chose (2026-10-30) a Scorer port with several scoring methods; the port is built only when a second method wins on new months. Round 3 (collection, round-3/plan.json) found that fusing word matching with embedding similarity gave the best average precision on most profiles; it was dropped only because its yes/no threshold failed, and the reader now ranks (rounds 10 and 11).

data.teaching: Product teaching (round 6: the reader shows the top N_teach by cos with the description and the top N_teach keyword matches; the answer key answers; ambiguous skipped), N_teach in {5, 10}, from the whole labelled pool: collection + fresh + fresh-2 + fresh-3 + fresh-4.
data.test: fresh-5: every the-decoder.com and siliconangle.com article published 2025-01-01..2025-03-31, crawled and prepared like fresh-4 (all earlier URLs and titles excluded), labelled for all 16 profiles by four blind annotators with profiles.md, frozen before any round-12 score; vectors checked as before.

rankers.hybrid: score = z(cos(x, d)) + z(lex(x)), where lex is the cosine of the article's tf-idf vector with the tf-idf vector of the profile's name + description + keywords (round 3's analyzer: lower-case, [a-z0-9]+, scikit-learn English stop words, nltk 3.9.2 Porter stemmer, sublinear tf, smooth idf, L2; idf fitted on the teaching pool's texts), and z standardises by the scored stream's mean and sd. No taught answer moves the order. Ties by cos(x, d), then id.
rankers.hybrid-rocchio: round 3's hybrid-rocchio with the taught answers of product teaching: z(cos(x, q_dense)) + z(cos(x_lex, q_lex)), q_dense = 8 d + 16 mean(taught relevant) - 4 mean(taught not relevant), q_lex = 8 q0_lex + 16 mean(taught relevant lex) - 4 mean(taught not relevant lex), q0_lex = name + description + keywords; terms with no relevant answer use 0; ties as above.

baselines: keywordNarrow and keywordBroad (matches first, newest first) and newest, as round 10.

metrics.map: AP per profile over the scored stream's labelled articles; mean over N_teach; macro over profiles with >= 20 strict relevant fresh-5 articles (MAP).
metrics.daily: Round 11's daily recall of the best N_day (3, 5, 10) per UTC day; macro over profiles with >= 20 days that hold a strict relevant article.
metrics.secondary: Daily precision, missed days, and both metrics per profile (reported only).

pass: Topic-level paired bootstrap (2000 replicates, numpy.random.default_rng(31965)). A hybrid ranker replaces desc+kw only when (1) the interval of (hybrid - desc+kw) MAP lies entirely above 0, and (2) the interval of (hybrid - desc+kw) daily recall has lower bound > -0.05. If both hybrids pass, the simpler (hybrid, no taught answers) wins unless its MAP interval against hybrid-rocchio lies entirely below 0.
then: A passing ranker becomes the second adapter of the Scorer port (#3383); the port's API is shown to the user before it is built.
noneEligible: desc+kw stays; the result goes to #3383 and the research record.
